claves: Un dermatofito (infecciones de la piel). Se ve un macroconidio largo y, alrededor, microconidios pequeños.

imagen.autor: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
imagen.descripcionOriginal: This micrograph shows hyphae (macroconidium) and microconidia of Trichophyton rubrum, a dermatophyte responsible for fungal infections of the skin. (credit: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention)
